name: Dulkara Horchata-Jackfruit Cream
description: A synth-horchata base blended with jackfruit extract, carbonated lightly and finished with a cinnamon-vanilla undertone. Selvane's attempt to capture the Tier 2 cream soda market with a familiar-yet-distinct flavor.
flavor_profile: Thick, milky sweetness upfront with tropical jackfruit funk; cinnamon lingers on the finish with a slight synthetic aftertaste common to synth-extract blends
cultural_context: Popular in Tier 1 break rooms and vending stacks — considered a comfort drink by Shelf workers who grew up with it; older residents associate it with cheaper, better times before corponation price hikes.
story_hooks: A Shelf worker's locker contains dozens of empty Dulkara cans — the investigating runner realizes they stopped buying them six weeks ago, right when they disappeared.
Selvane's synth-jackfruit formula was allegedly stolen from a small street chemist in the Midden District; she's still alive and still angry.
The horchata compound in Dulkara reacts unpredictably with a specific black-market BCI stabilizer, causing vivid gustatory hallucinations — and someone is exploiting this.
